done_when: A Not done finding whose title holds an owner-approved Done-when item, also with added words after it, blocks close and does not become a follow-up. A Not done finding about builder details stays a follow-up.
why: A fix merges while review says its own Done-when is not done: when a Not done finding's title holds the fix's Done-when with added words, Forge treats it as advice (GitHub issue 1273).
